actions.action: Enforce expiry at the display boundary
actions.mechanism: Check expiry continuously, not just during synchronization; stop early enough to cover the clock’s 30-second uncertainty.
actions.implementation: Display timestamped items only while device time plus 30 seconds precedes expiry. Schedule removal and recheck after restart or resume.
actions.check: Disconnect for six hours with clocks offset by ±30 seconds; verify rendered frames contain no items after true expiry.
actions.risk: Items may disappear up to 60 seconds early.

actions.mechanism: Durable per-ID revision floors and ordered configuration generations prevent delayed updates from restoring removed content.
actions.implementation: Record revocations against item revisions; reject equal-or-older revisions and previously superseded generations. Require a strictly newer revision for intentional republication.
actions.check: Remove an item, reboot, then deliver duplicated and reordered older bundles; verify the item remains absent.
actions.risk: Revision floors require durable storage and a defined retention strategy.

actions.mechanism: Transactional activation prevents interrupted reconnects from mixing new removals with older display state.
actions.implementation: Stage and validate each bundle; commit items, revision barriers, and generation together. Render only committed state, applying expiry checks throughout recovery.
actions.check: Interrupt power at each installation step; recovery must expose a complete committed configuration without losing any committed removal.
actions.risk: Staging requires additional local storage; invalid updates leave older eligible content active.

actions.mechanism: A persistent status distinguishes locally enforceable expiry from removals that require a successfully applied update.
actions.implementation: Show last successful configuration application time. While disconnected, state: “Scheduled expiry enforced; removals issued since this update may not be reflected.”
actions.check: During a six-hour outage, verify status remains visible and advances only after successful application, not merely reconnection.
actions.risk: Status text consumes display space and must remain understandable.

actions.action: Enforce a strict configuration size budget
actions.mechanism: Admission control keeps every complete bundle below 100 KB without silently dropping removals or metadata.
actions.implementation: Set a conservative 99,000-byte ceiling on both encoded and decoded bundles, including metadata. Reject oversized publication; reduce content explicitly before retrying.
actions.check: Test boundary sizes and highly compressible oversized payloads; rejected bundles must never replace the committed configuration.
actions.risk: Capacity failures can delay updates; publication errors must be surfaced promptly.
